title: BirService chart values
description: Schema for tenant values.yaml. Validated by Helm at install/template time and by IDEs (VSCode yaml-language-server reads charts/*/values.schema.json automatically). Single source of truth: extend BirServiceSpec → easy-deploy-platform CRD schema → regenerate this file. Supports two shapes: single-instance (operational keys at root) or multi-instance (instance maps at root + shared service-level keys like repo, owner).

instance.$comment: Schema for a multi-instance entry (e.g. 'main:', 'slave:'). Mirrors the root schema minus service-level keys (name, owner). additionalProperties:false rejects typos like 'trafficc'. Required image/repo is NOT enforced because instances can inherit those from a sibling service.yaml.

inheritFrom.description: Inherit the full config of the named sibling instance (e.g. 'main'); fields declared here override the inherited ones (deep merge). The target instance must not itself use inheritFrom (no chains).

route.description: Join this instance to a sibling's shared hostname/HTTPRoute instead of creating its own. The named parent must be a sibling instance that does not itself use route.shareWith.

shareWith.description: Name of the sibling instance whose hostname to share (e.g. 'main').

pathPrefix.description: Only this path prefix routes to this instance under the shared host (e.g. /testing). The parent serves everything else.

weight.description: Weighted split percentage on the shared host's catch-all (used when pathPrefix is omitted).

name.description: BirService CR name. Auto-derived from Helm release name if empty.

owner.description: Service owner (free text). Propagated as deploy.easydeploy.io/owner annotation. Typically lives in service.yaml so all environments share the same value.

repo.description: Image repo (ghcr.io/acme/app) or Git URL (https://github.com/user/app). Exclusive with image.

tag.description: Image tag or git ref. Default: latest for image repos, main for git repos.

imageTag.description: Rollback override — previous build SHA (e.g. abc1234).

dockerfile.description: Dockerfile path relative to repo root. Default: Dockerfile.

port.description: Service port. 0 or omitted = auto-detect from image or default 8080.

containerPort.description: Container port. 0 or omitted = same as port.

replicas.description: Fixed pod count. Default 1 if HPA is not set. Ignored if hpa.minReplicas/maxReplicas are set.

hpa.description: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler. Both fields required together. Ignored if replicas is set.

minReplicas.description: 0 disables HPA. >=1 enables HPA when paired with maxReplicas.

maxReplicas.description: 0 disables HPA. >=1 enables HPA when paired with minReplicas.

resources.description: Container resource requests/limits. Defaults: requests cpu=75m memory=200Mi; limits 2x requests.

hostnames.description: Additional DNS aliases served by the same workload (one HTTPRoute, multiple hostnames). All share the same pods and rate limit.

metrics.description: Prometheus ServiceMonitor. true (default) = enabled with /metrics; false = disabled; object = custom path.

traffic.description: Mesh traffic policies. Presence implies mesh enabled (Istio).

ejectUnhealthy.description: Outlier detection. Default true. Set false for workloads that legitimately return 5xx.

latencyAware.description: LB algorithm. Default false (round-robin). True = least-request. Verify with P50/P99 histograms before enabling.

singleton.description: App can run only one version at a time (leader-elected, exclusive lock, in-memory state). Default false → zero-downtime rolling. True → brief downtime, PDB skipped.

maxDown.description: Max pods that may be unavailable during voluntary disruptions (node drains, upgrades). Default floor(replicas/2). 0 forbids voluntary disruption.

preStopSleepSeconds.description: Endpoint drain wait before SIGTERM. Default 15.

injectPipeline.description: When true (default for git repos), operator injects GitHub Actions build workflow into the repo.
